name: reel-06-bubble-vs-lovable
lines: Bubble vs Lovable. Which no-code AI builder should you actually use?
Bubble: you drag the app together visually. Most control, built-in database.
Lovable: you describe it in plain English and AI writes real code you own.
Building a full product to run a business? Bubble.
Want a working app this afternoon? Lovable.
Either way, the AI is the cheap part. Pick one and ship.

name: reel-07-sunday-drop
lines: This week, one idea kept coming up.
The AI is the cheapest part of an AI business.
Louis pays $30 a month for the AI behind his app. It pays him $15,000.
The money is not in the model. It is in the problem you pick and the audience you build.
Both are free. Neither is the code.

name: reel-08-five-boring
lines: 5 boring AI businesses quietly printing money.
Turning plain English into Excel formulas. $226,000 a month.
Cleaning voice notes into clear writing. $15,000 a month.
Chasing unpaid invoices for freelancers. Every month.
Writing show notes for podcasters. Every month.
None are exciting. All are painful problems people pay to kill.
cta: Steal the playbook, link in bio

name: reel-10-formula-bot
lines: A data analyst built a $226,000-a-month app over a weekend.
It does one boring thing: turn plain English into Excel formulas.
No code. Just Bubble and an AI model, $25 a month to run.
He posted it once to Reddit. Woke up to 100,000 visitors.
The build took a weekend. The distribution did the rest.
